articles.title_en: Cashew processing in Ghana – A case for infant industry support?
articles.title_cn: 加纳的腰果加工——支持幼稚产业的案例？
articles.abstract_en: West Africa produces almost half of the world's cashew nuts. With the domestic cashew processing industry still in its infancy, however, most of it is exported as raw material and processed in India and Vietnam. In Ghana, this is provoking discussions about market interventions to support domestic processing. Since different price policies have diverging implications for farmers and processors, the choice of the policy instrument leads to conflicts of interest between the two groups. In this study, we analyse the short- and long-term economic impacts of enhancing cashew processing through (i.) a temporary export tax on raw cashew nuts, (ii.) a temporary subsidy to cashew processors, and (iii.)a temporary export tax on raw cashew nuts, with government revenues passed on to cashew growers. For this purpose, we develop a partial equilibrium model for the Ghanaian cashew market including the processing from raw cashew nuts to kernels. We find that in the short run, all price policies lead to a substantial increase in processing at the expense of net welfare. We argue, however, that the sector may experience productivity gains through learning by doing and thus, after price policies are phased out, stick to its increased level of output such that short-term welfare losses could be recouped. Therefore, temporarily introduced price policies could help the infant cashew processing industry to grow up, promote the development of the domestic cashew sector, and be welfare-enhancing in the long run. A subsidy to processors is the most appropriate option to achieve this.
articles.abstract_cn: 西非生产了全球近一半的腰果。然而，由于国内腰果加工业仍处于起步阶段，大部分腰果作为原材料出口，并在印度和越南进行加工。在加纳，这引发了关于支持国内加工的市场干预措施的讨论。由于不同的价格政策对农民和加工商有不同的影响，政策工具的选择导致两个群体之间的利益冲突。在本研究中，我们分析了通过（i）对生腰果征收临时出口税，（ii）对腰果加工商提供临时补贴，以及（iii）对生腰果征收临时出口税并将政府收入转给腰果种植者，来促进腰果加工的短期和长期经济影响。为此，我们为加纳腰果市场开发了一个部分均衡模型，包括从生腰果到腰果仁的加工过程。我们发现，在短期内，所有价格政策都会导致加工量大幅增加，但以净福利为代价。然而，我们认为，该行业可能通过干中学获得生产率提升，因此在价格政策逐步取消后，仍能保持其增加后的产出水平，从而短期福利损失可以得到弥补。因此，临时引入的价格政策可以帮助幼稚的腰果加工业成长，促进国内腰果部门的发展，并在长期内提高福利。对加工商提供补贴是实现这一目标的最合适选择。

articles.title_en: The impact of CAP subsidies on the productivity of cereal farms in six European countries: A historical perspective (2008–2018)
articles.title_cn: CAP补贴对六个欧洲国家谷物农场生产率的影响：历史视角（2008-2018）
articles.abstract_en: Productivity is an always-hotly-debated issue within the EU agricultural policymaking, particularly concerning the effect of subsidies distributed via the Common Agricultural Policy (CAP). The cereal sector is under particular political scrutiny nowadays, with the Ukraine conflict and environmental issues menacing food security levels for both developing and developed countries.
articles.abstract_cn: 生产率是欧盟农业政策制定中一个始终激烈争论的问题，特别是关于通过共同农业政策（CAP）分配的补贴的影响。如今，谷物部门受到特别的政治关注，乌克兰冲突和环境问题威胁着发展中国家和发达国家的粮食安全水平。

articles.title_en: Consumers' preferences for commons-based and open-source produce: A discrete choice experiment with directional information manipulations
articles.title_cn: 消费者对基于共有和开源农产品的偏好：一项带有方向性信息操纵的离散选择实验
articles.abstract_en: The increasing privatization of seeds and varieties through intellectual property rights such as patents and exclusive seed multiplication rights has led to power imbalances and contributes to the continuous decline of genetic diversity. Diversified agricultural systems are, however, essential for climate change adaptation and the long-term resilience of our food systems. Common ownership of seeds and varieties can play a central role in supporting the development of diversified agricultural systems. With the first commons/open-source varieties entering consumer markets, consumer preferences and willingness-to-pay (WTP) for these varieties are worth exploring. On the example of tomatoes, we carried out a representative consumer survey with a discrete choice experiment. We find that consumers prefer commons/open-source varieties to company-owned varieties and are willing to pay a premium for these varieties. However, the premium they are willing to pay is smaller than for locally grown and organic produce. Providing additional information on the advantages of commons/open-source varieties positively affects WTP. There are no differences in WTP values for ‘commons varieties’ and ‘open-source varieties’. Our findings contribute to academic and policy discourses on consumers’ role in agrobiodiversity conservation and enhancement.
articles.abstract_cn: 通过专利和独家种子繁殖权等知识产权，种子和品种的日益私有化导致了权力失衡，并加剧了遗传多样性的持续下降。然而，多样化的农业系统对于适应气候变化和我们粮食系统的长期韧性至关重要。种子和品种的共有所有权可以在支持多样化农业系统发展中发挥核心作用。随着首批共有/开源品种进入消费市场，消费者对这些品种的偏好和支付意愿（WTP）值得探讨。以番茄为例，我们进行了一项具有代表性的消费者调查，并采用了离散选择实验。我们发现，消费者偏好共有/开源品种而非公司拥有的品种，并愿意为这些品种支付溢价。然而，他们愿意支付的溢价低于本地种植和有机农产品。提供关于共有/开源品种优势的额外信息对支付意愿有积极影响。‘共有品种’和‘开源品种’的支付意愿值没有差异。我们的发现为关于消费者在农业生物多样性保护和增强中作用的学术和政策讨论做出了贡献。

articles.title_en: Food system labor and bargaining power
articles.title_cn: 食品系统劳动力与议价能力
articles.abstract_en: Historically, pandemics lead to labor shortages, and the COVID-19 pandemic of 2020-21 proved to be no different. While there are many explanations for supply-chain issues reported in a number of industries, the proximate cause for ongoing problems in producing, processing, and delivering food to consumers has been attributed to a lack of labor. If this is the case, then the apparent shortage is likely to manifest in greater bargaining power by workers in the food and agriculture industry, defined generally, during the COVID pandemic. In this paper, we test whether the COVID-19 pandemic is associated with greater bargaining power among food and agriculture workers using a structural model of labor search-and-bargaining, and examine the effect of policy responses to COVID-19 on labor-market outcomes. Using data from the American Community Survey (ACS, Bureau of Census) for wage outcomes in 2019 and 2020, we find that the COVID pandemic was responsible for a 5.7% increase in bargaining power for employed workers. Our counterfactual simulations examine the impact of two labor-market interventions – minimum-wages and unemployment insurance – on equilibrium wages. We find that lower minimum wages leave more employment surplus to employers, allowing them to bid up equilibrium wages, while more generous unemployment insurance reduces the supply of labor, and increases equilibrium wages.
articles.abstract_cn: 历史上，流行病导致劳动力短缺，而2020-21年的COVID-19疫情也不例外。尽管对多个行业报告的供应链问题有多种解释，但生产、加工和向消费者交付食品的持续问题的直接原因被归因于劳动力缺乏。如果是这样，那么明显的短缺很可能在COVID疫情期间表现为食品和农业行业（广义定义）工人议价能力的增强。在本文中，我们使用劳动力搜索与议价的结构模型，检验COVID-19疫情是否与食品和农业工人议价能力的增强相关，并考察COVID-19政策应对措施对劳动力市场结果的影响。利用美国社区调查（ACS，人口普查局）2019年和2020年的工资结果数据，我们发现COVID疫情导致就业工人议价能力增加了5.7%。我们的反事实模拟考察了两种劳动力市场干预措施——最低工资和失业保险——对均衡工资的影响。我们发现，较低的最低工资给雇主留下更多的就业剩余，使他们能够抬高均衡工资，而更慷慨的失业保险减少了劳动力供给，并提高了均衡工资。

articles.title_en: The crop insurance demand response to premium subsidies: Evidence from U.S. Agriculture
articles.title_cn: 作物保险需求对保费补贴的响应：来自美国农业的证据
articles.abstract_en: Premium subsidies are a common policy tool to promote crop insurance participation in many countries. However, the relationship between subsidies and demand is not entirely obvious given the variation in the use of subsidies and crop insurance participation within the international crop insurance landscape. Focusing on the U.S. Federal Crop Insurance Program (FCIP) demand is modeled as a system of equations representing decisions at the intensive [coverage level] and extensive [net insured acres] margins. The model makes use of an identification strategy that leverages exogenous variation in government-set pricing policy to address potential sources of endogeneity. Applying the model to over one million insurance pool level FCIP observations spanning two decades (2001–2022) suggest an inelastic response at both extensive and intensive margins to changes in producer-paid premium rates with the response to premium rates becoming increasingly more elastic as subsidies decrease. These estimated elasticities are on the low end compared to previous literature, however, significant heterogeneity across commodity, production practices, policy type, and location are observed suggesting subsets of producers are likely to respond to changes in the cost of insurance in different ways.
articles.abstract_cn: 保费补贴是许多国家促进作物保险参与度的常见政策工具。然而，鉴于国际作物保险格局中补贴使用和作物保险参与度的差异，补贴与需求之间的关系并不完全明显。聚焦于美国联邦作物保险计划（FCIP），需求被建模为一个方程组，代表集约边际（保障水平）和粗放边际（净投保面积）上的决策。该模型利用了一种识别策略，该策略利用政府设定的定价政策中的外生变化来解决潜在的内生性来源。将该模型应用于跨越二十年（2001-2022年）的超过一百万个保险池层面的FCIP观测值，结果表明，在粗放边际和集约边际上，对生产者支付的保费率变化的响应均缺乏弹性，且随着补贴减少，对保费率的响应变得越来越有弹性。与以往文献相比，这些估计的弹性处于较低端，然而，观察到商品、生产实践、政策类型和地点之间存在显著的异质性，这表明生产者子集可能以不同方式对保险成本的变化做出响应。

articles.title_en: Agri-food importing firms amid a global health crisis
articles.title_cn: 全球健康危机中的农产品进口企业
articles.abstract_en: This paper exploits daily customs transaction data on the universe of Swiss agri-food importing firms to assess the response of firms to a global shock. Estimating a linear model that regresses product-level import margins on daily COVID19 shocks and a host of fixed effects, we find that the pandemic had a substantial trade-reducing effect on imports. The trade effects were driven mainly by a reduction in the number of importing firms (i.e., 63% of the total effect), and much less by the number of products imported and the average import value per product per firm. We explore several sources of heterogeneity and show, among others, that larger and incumbent firms were affected more by the trade adjustments. Our results also reveal that the relative contribution of each import margin to the decline in aggregate imports depends on the level of data aggregation (i.e., daily, weekly or monthly). Finally, we validate and confirm our main findings by testing two mechanisms: (i) third-country supply-side effects using insights from structural gravity models and (ii) changes to consumer demand using consumer mobility, and retailer and consumer scanner data.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文利用瑞士农产品进口企业全样本的每日海关交易数据，评估企业对全球冲击的反应。通过估计一个将产品层面的进口边际回归于每日COVID19冲击及一系列固定效应的线性模型，我们发现疫情对进口产生了显著的贸易减少效应。贸易效应主要由进口企业数量的减少驱动（占总效应的63%），而产品进口数量和企业每产品平均进口价值的影响较小。我们探讨了多种异质性来源，并表明，在其他因素中，规模较大和现有企业受贸易调整的影响更大。我们的结果还揭示，每个进口边际对总进口下降的相对贡献取决于数据聚合的水平（即每日、每周或每月）。最后，我们通过测试两种机制来验证并确认我们的主要发现：（i）使用结构引力模型的见解来检验第三国供应侧效应，以及（ii）使用消费者流动性、零售商和消费者扫描数据来检验消费者需求的变化。

articles.title_en: Challenges and opportunities for increasing the effectiveness of food reformulation and fortification to improve dietary and nutrition outcomes
articles.title_cn: 提高食品重组和强化有效性以改善饮食和营养结果的挑战与机遇
articles.abstract_en: Reformulation, a change to a food or beverage's processing or composition, can reduce potentially harmful ingredients such as salt, added sugar, and saturated and trans fats or increase potentially beneficial ingredients or nutrients such as fiber, protein, and micronutrients. Poor nutrition and health outcomes of populations have stimulated programs and policies to reduce the intake of salt, added sugar, and unhealthy fats and increase healthy nutrients and ingredients to meet recommended targets of a healthy diet. Alongside promoting the consumption of whole, nutritious foods (e.g., fruits, vegetables, and whole grains), reformulation, including fortification of processed foods, has been utilized by food industry manufacturers to contribute to improving diets and aligning with national dietary guidelines. This paper summarizes a literature review and twenty semi-structured interviews with experts on food product reformulation and fortification to highlight the challenges, limitations, and opportunities for increasing their effectiveness. While studies have shown that reformulation could have beneficial public health impacts, such as iodized salt, there are a dearth of rigorous evaluations, particularly for some types of reformulations. Importantly, some evidence suggests that ultra-processing has significant adverse health effects independently of nutrient adequacy. To improve population health, reformulation should be complemented with a range of approaches, including food taxes and subsidies, public food procurement, restrictions on food advertising and marketing, front-of-pack labeling, and changes to food environments that improve availability, affordability, and demand for whole and minimally processed foods.
articles.abstract_cn: 重组，即改变食品或饮料的加工或成分，可以减少潜在有害成分如盐、添加糖、饱和脂肪和反式脂肪，或增加潜在有益成分或营养素如纤维、蛋白质和微量营养素。人群营养和健康结果不佳，促使制定计划和政策以减少盐、添加糖和不健康脂肪的摄入，并增加健康营养素和成分，以达到健康饮食的推荐目标。在促进消费完整、营养丰富的食品（如水果、蔬菜和全谷物）的同时，食品行业制造商也利用重组（包括加工食品的强化）来改善饮食并符合国家膳食指南。本文总结了文献综述和二十次与食品重组和强化专家的半结构化访谈，以强调提高其有效性的挑战、局限性和机遇。虽然研究表明重组可能产生有益于公共健康的影响，如加碘盐，但缺乏严格的评估，特别是对于某些类型的重组。重要的是，一些证据表明，超加工对健康有显著的不利影响，独立于营养素充足性。为了改善人群健康，重组应辅以一系列方法，包括食品税和补贴、公共食品采购、限制食品广告和营销、包装正面标签，以及改善食品环境，提高完整和最低加工食品的可获得性、可负担性和需求。

articles.title_en: Food trade and regional trade agreements – A network perspective
articles.title_cn: 食品贸易与区域贸易协定——一个网络视角
articles.abstract_en: Since the establishment of the World Trade Organization (WTO) also the number of Regional Trade Agreements (RTAs) has risen strongly, from less than 50 in 1995 to more than 350 in 2022. Increasingly overlapping RTAs imply challenges and can raise trade costs associated with the management of multiple trade rules and regulatory standards. At the same time, countries that are connected through several RTAs could be strongly integrated and their regulatory approaches well-aligned, thus reducing trade costs among them. This paper looks at the parallels in the evolution of agricultural trade and RTAs and asks how the layering of RTAs is associated with agricultural trade among their signatories and with countries outside the RTAs. Based on network measures and correlations we identify common patterns in the evolution of RTAs globally and agricultural trade of a balanced panel of 190 countries in the years 1995, 2007, 2013 and 2019. We also provide first indication on the interaction of overlapping RTAs and agricultural trade. On global average, our findings hint at a positive association between RTA and agricultural trade connectivity and suggest that this relationship could be more pronounced at the extensive margin of trade and for countries that share several RTAs, possibly indicating a stronger political integration among these countries.
articles.abstract_cn: 自世界贸易组织（WTO）成立以来，区域贸易协定（RTAs）的数量也大幅增加，从1995年的不到50个增至2022年的超过350个。日益重叠的RTAs意味着挑战，并可能提高与多种贸易规则和监管标准管理相关的贸易成本。与此同时，通过多个RTAs连接的国家可能实现高度一体化，其监管方法也可能高度协调，从而降低它们之间的贸易成本。本文考察了农业贸易与RTAs演进的相似之处，并探讨RTAs的叠加如何与其签署国之间以及与非RTA成员国的农业贸易相关联。基于网络测度和相关性分析，我们识别了1995年、2007年、2013年和2019年全球RTAs演进及190个国家平衡面板农业贸易的常见模式。我们还提供了重叠RTAs与农业贸易相互作用的初步证据。在全球平均水平上，我们的研究结果暗示RTA与农业贸易连通性之间存在正相关关系，并表明这种关系在贸易的扩展边际以及共享多个RTAs的国家之间可能更为显著，这可能表明这些国家之间的政治一体化程度更高。

articles.title_en: Farmland Leasing, misallocation Reduction, and agricultural total factor Productivity: Insights from rice production in China
articles.title_cn: 农地流转、错配减少与农业全要素生产率：来自中国水稻生产的启示
articles.abstract_en: Reducing factor misallocation is crucial for enhancing agricultural aggregate total factor productivity (TFP) and narrowing the income gap between urban and rural areas in China. This paper presents a theoretical framework illustrating how farmland leasing affects aggregated TFP via the reduction of misallocation. Utilizing a comprehensive dataset of cost and benefit survey for Jiangsu rice farmers, monthly surface climatological data, and soil characteristic information from FAO, this study finds that efficient factor reallocation could theoretically result in a 23.6% increase in aggregate TFP. In practice, a 1% increase in farmland leasing leads to a 1.087% gain in aggregate TFP and a 0.267% reduction in misallocation using IV regression. These effects become larger after the Three Rights Separation (TRS) reform compared to prior conditions. The mediation effects of farmland leasing on TFP through misallocation reduction are only observed in Southern Jiangsu, possibly due to farmland concentration.
articles.abstract_cn: 减少要素错配对于提高中国农业总全要素生产率（TFP）和缩小城乡收入差距至关重要。本文提出了一个理论框架，说明农地流转如何通过减少错配来影响总TFP。利用江苏省水稻种植户的成本收益调查综合数据集、月度地表气候数据以及FAO的土壤特征信息，本研究发现，有效的要素重新配置理论上可使总TFP提高23.6%。在实践中，使用IV回归，农地流转每增加1%，总TFP提高1.087%，错配减少0.267%。与改革前相比，三权分置改革后这些效应变得更大。农地流转通过减少错配对TFP的中介效应仅在苏南地区观察到，这可能与农地集中有关。

articles.title_en: Identifying food policy coherence in Italian regional policies: The case of Emilia-Romagna
articles.title_cn: 识别意大利区域政策中的食品政策一致性：以艾米利亚-罗马涅为例
articles.abstract_en: Achieving a coherent set of food-related policies is a challenge for policymakers worldwide, as food matters are addressed at more than one level of governance and across several policy domains. Policies in different domains can sustain each other by sharing the same objectives and actions or they can hinder each other, resulting in different levels of coherence. Focusing on the case study of the region Emilia-Romagna (Italy), the present research aims to answer the following research questions: to what extent is food mentioned in regional policies? Are the food-related objectives of Emilia-Romagna policies coherent with each other? Mixed methods were used in three subsequent research steps. Step 1 consisted of collating an inventory of regional policies where food is present. In Step 2, identified policies were analysed with quantitative content analysis, to examine their objectives, degree of targeting, which food supply chain step they focus on, and which policy instrument type they plan to use. Step 3 aimed to assess the coherence of the identified food-related policies’ objectives among each other through expert interviews, analysed with thematic coding. Overall, regional policies reached a good degree of coherence around the common intention of making Emilia-Romagna thrive economically. However, some level of incoherence is present, as a systematic process that lowers incoherence in policymaking is not in place yet. Therefore, implementing the use of a Policy Coherence Matrix as a standardised practice for policy approval is recommended to coordinate food-related policies.
articles.abstract_cn: 实现一套连贯的食品相关政策对世界各地的政策制定者来说是一个挑战，因为食品问题在多个治理层面和多个政策领域得到处理。不同领域的政策可以通过共享相同的目标和行动相互支持，或者相互阻碍，导致不同程度的一致性。本研究以艾米利亚-罗马涅（意大利）地区为案例，旨在回答以下研究问题：食品在区域政策中被提及的程度如何？艾米利亚-罗马涅政策中与食品相关的目标是否相互一致？在三个后续研究步骤中使用了混合方法。步骤一包括汇编一份涉及食品的区域政策清单。在步骤2中，通过定量内容分析对已识别的政策进行分析，以考察其目标、目标定位程度、关注的食品供应链环节以及计划使用的政策工具类型。步骤三旨在通过专家访谈评估已识别的食品相关政策目标之间的一致性，并使用主题编码进行分析。总体而言，区域政策在使艾米利亚-罗马涅经济繁荣的共同意图上达到了一致性。然而，由于尚未建立系统性的流程来降低政策制定中的不一致性，仍存在一定程度的不一致。因此，建议将政策一致性矩阵作为政策批准的标准化实践，以协调食品相关政策。

articles.title_en: Environmental efficiency and methane abatement costs of dairy farms from Minas Gerais, Brazil
articles.title_cn: 巴西米纳斯吉拉斯州奶牛场的环境效率与甲烷减排成本
articles.abstract_en: Increasing dairy farm productivity while simultaneously mitigating greenhouse gases emissions is a common policy goal in many countries. In this paper, we assess trade-offs and synergies between these goals for pasture-based dairy farms in Brazil. We apply stochastic frontier analysis within a translog hyperbolic distance function specification, including methane emissions as an undesirable output and accounting for annual climatic types. Our results indicate that on average, farmers can improve their production by 9.4% while simultaneously reducing methane emissions by 8.7%. The adoption of more productive cows and improved pastures have a positive effect on the environmental efficiency of the farms. Farmers operating in warmer and dryer climate types tend to have lower environmental efficiency. Calculating shadow prices for methane emitted on farms indicates that the mean abatement costs of methane are US $2,254 per tonne. Overall, by reducing inefficiency, dairy farmers can significantly increase farm production while simultaneously reducing emissions and thus contribute to national commitments to eradicate hunger and mitigate methane emissions.
articles.abstract_cn: 提高奶牛场生产率同时减少温室气体排放是许多国家的共同政策目标。本文评估了巴西放牧型奶牛场在这些目标之间的权衡与协同效应。我们采用超越对数双曲线距离函数规范中的随机前沿分析，将甲烷排放作为非合意产出，并考虑年度气候类型。结果表明，平均而言，农民可以在提高生产9.4%的同时减少甲烷排放8.7%。采用更高产奶牛和改良牧场对农场的环境效率有积极影响。在较温暖和干燥气候类型下经营的农场往往具有较低的环境效率。计算农场甲烷排放的影子价格表明，甲烷的平均减排成本为每吨US $2,254。总体而言，通过减少低效率，奶牛场可以显著增加农场生产，同时减少排放，从而为国家消除饥饿和减少甲烷排放的承诺做出贡献。

articles.title_en: Unfair trading practices and countervailing power
articles.title_cn: 不公平贸易行为与抗衡力量
articles.abstract_en: This paper investigates whether countervailing power of collective initiatives (cooperatives, producer organizations, associations) can mitigate unfair trading practices in agricultural markets. The study hypothesis is that collective initiatives exerting countervailing power can attenuate the imbalance in the distribution of bargaining power that is considered one of the main causes of unfair trading practices. Our findings suggest that in a multidimensional bargaining setting where all contract terms are negotiated at once, there is no theoretical expectation that exerting countervailing power necessarily results in a mitigation of unfair trading practices. To investigate the topic empirically, we used a data set measuring fairness perception of a sample of Italian kiwifruit producers. The data support the hypothesis that membership in collective initiatives increases the probability that a farmer perceives a transaction as fair. However, countervailing power does not counter all unfair practices in the same way. While patrons of collective initiatives perceive benefits in price and quality determination practices, no such effect was found for contract renegotiation. The analysis compares two policy approaches: supporting countervailing power and banning specific practices (such as EU Directive 633/2019). We conclude that countervailing power is less effective in targeting specific unfair practices, but it is less likely to determine efficiency loss because it does not impose constraints on contractual negotiations.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文研究了集体倡议（合作社、生产者组织、协会）的抗衡力量能否减轻农产品市场中的不公平贸易行为。研究假设是，发挥抗衡力量的集体倡议能够削弱议价能力分配的不平衡，而这种不平衡被认为是不公平贸易行为的主要原因之一。我们的研究结果表明，在合同条款一次性谈判的多维议价环境中，理论上并不能预期发挥抗衡力量必然导致不公平贸易行为的减轻。为了实证研究该主题，我们使用了衡量意大利猕猴桃生产者样本公平感知的数据集。数据支持以下假设：加入集体倡议增加了农民认为交易公平的概率。然而，抗衡力量并不能以相同方式对抗所有不公平做法。虽然集体倡议的参与者认为在价格和质量确定实践中受益，但在合同重新谈判方面未发现此类效应。分析比较了两种政策方法：支持抗衡力量和禁止特定做法（如欧盟指令633/2019）。我们得出结论，抗衡力量在针对特定不公平做法方面效果较差，但因其不对合同谈判施加限制，故不太可能导致效率损失。

articles.title_en: Econometric assessment of the effects of COVID-19 outbreaks on U.S. meat production and plant utilization with plant-level data
articles.title_cn: 基于工厂层面数据的COVID-19疫情对美国肉类生产及工厂利用率影响的计量经济学评估
articles.abstract_en: This paper quantifies the impact of the COVID-19 disruption on U.S. meatpacking production. We employ a confidential plant-level meatpacking plant data set from USDA that gives daily livestock (cattle, swine, broilers) slaughter by individual firms and their individual plants. We found a larger underutilization rate of processing capacity for larger-sized beef and pork plants during the peak of plant slowdowns in April-May 2020, while no such relationship was found for broiler plants. In our panel analysis of beef packing plants, we found that higher COVID-19 infection rates in a county were associated with greater plant disruptions, but that plants appear to have been able to adjust relatively quickly to these disruptions. Our empirical analysis suggests a beef plant distribution with fewer large plants could have meant smaller shocks to production during the initial surge of COVID-19 disruptions. However, beef plant size was significantly less important to maximizing utilization of processing capacity after the initial surge.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文量化了COVID-19疫情对美国肉类加工生产的影响。我们使用了美国农业部提供的机密工厂层面肉类加工数据集，该数据集包含各企业及其个体工厂的每日牲畜（牛、猪、肉鸡）屠宰量。我们发现，在2020年四月至五月工厂停工高峰期，大型牛肉和猪肉加工厂的产能利用率不足率更高，而肉鸡工厂则未发现此类关系。在对牛肉加工厂的面板分析中，我们发现一个县较高的COVID-19感染率与更大的工厂中断相关，但工厂似乎能够相对较快地适应这些中断。我们的实证分析表明，拥有较少大型工厂的牛肉工厂分布可能意味着在COVID-19疫情初期冲击期间生产受到的冲击较小。然而，在初期冲击之后，牛肉工厂规模对于最大化加工产能利用率的重要性显著降低。

articles.title_en: Empirical insights on the dynamics of SPS trade costs: The role of regulatory convergence and experience in EU dairy trade
articles.title_cn: SPS贸易成本动态的实证洞察：监管趋同与经验在欧盟乳制品贸易中的作用
articles.abstract_en: With its influence on the world stage, the EU’s Farm to Fork initiative seeks to extend sustainable and fair food production practises globally, in part, by encouraging convergence with EU food standards (i.e., sanitary and phytosanitary measures-SPS). Harmonisation clauses have been found empirically to encourage trade, but no quantifiable estimates exist on the trade effects of SPS regulatory convergence. This paper examines this issue for the dairy industry, a highly regulated sector with significant sustainability concerns attached. Furthermore, the cost-saving effects arising from closer regulations and ‘experience’ (i.e., accumulated years of foreign trade track-record), are compared. Employing a 3-year interval panel starting in 2010, a structural gravity equation that includes domestic trade is estimated with a flexible empirical approach that evinces asymmetric trade impacts for specific bilateral trade routes. Results indicate a trade depressing effect for SPS measures, estimated as a global average 10.4% Ad-valorem Equivalent (AVE). Moreover, at the global level, converging regulatory frameworks generate larger trade gains than experience, where a 1% rise in regulatory convergence is equivalent to 5 years of positive trade and a 14% reduction of the AVE. The reduction of trade frictions prompted by harmonisation and experience does not, however, outweigh SPS trade costs. Exporters to the EU face a higher SPS AVE than that faced by the EU (10.1% vs 9.3%). On average, exporters to the EU also benefit from a 9% saving due to experience, although cost savings from regulatory convergence are only reported for larger exporters to the EU, whose consolidated position in EU markets also grants them even greater than average benefits from years of accumulated experience.
articles.abstract_cn: 凭借其在世界舞台上的影响力，欧盟的“从农场到餐桌”倡议旨在通过鼓励与欧盟食品标准（即卫生与植物卫生措施-SPS）趋同，在全球范围内推广可持续和公平的食品生产实践。实证研究发现，协调条款能促进贸易，但关于SPS监管趋同的贸易效应尚无量化估计。本文针对乳制品行业（一个高度监管且具有重大可持续性问题的行业）研究这一问题。此外，比较了因监管趋近和“经验”（即累积的外贸记录年限）而产生的成本节约效应。采用从2010年开始的3年间隔面板数据，使用灵活的经验方法估计包含国内贸易的结构性引力方程，该方法揭示了特定双边贸易路线的非对称贸易影响。结果表明，SPS措施具有贸易抑制效应，估计全球平均10.4%的从价关税等值（AVE）。此外，在全球层面，监管框架趋同产生的贸易收益大于经验，其中监管趋同度提高1%相当于5年的积极贸易和AVE降低14%。然而，由协调和经验推动的贸易摩擦减少并未超过SPS贸易成本。对欧盟的出口商面临的SPS AVE高于欧盟自身（10.1%对9.3%）。平均而言，对欧盟的出口商也因经验而享有9%的成本节约，尽管监管趋同带来的成本节约仅见于对欧盟的较大出口商，这些出口商在欧盟市场的稳固地位也使其从多年累积经验中获得高于平均水平的收益。

articles.title_en: Near-real-time welfare and livelihood impacts of an active war: Evidence from Ethiopia
articles.title_cn: 一场持续战争的近实时福利与生计影响：来自埃塞俄比亚的证据
articles.abstract_en: Ethiopia recently experienced a large-scale war that lasted for more than two years. Using unique High-Frequency Phone Survey (HFPS) data, which span several months before and after the outbreak of the war, this paper provides evidence on the immediate impacts of the conflict on households’ food security. We also assess potential mechanisms and evaluate impacts on proximate outcomes, including on livelihood activities and access to food markets. We use difference-in-differences and two-way fixed effects estimation to compare trends across affected and unaffected regions (households) and before and after the outbreak of the war. Seven months into the conflict, we find that the war was associated with a 37 percentage points increase in the probability of moderate to severe food insecurity. Using the Armed Conflict Location and Event Data (ACLED), we show that exposure to an additional battle leads to a 1 percentage point increase in the probability of moderate or severe food insecurity. The conflict was associated with significant reduction in access to food through supply chain disruptions and by curtailing non-farm livelihood activities. Non-farm and wage related activities were affected the most, whereas farming activities were relatively more resilient. Our estimates, which likely underestimate the true average effects on the population, constitute novel evidence on the near-real-time impacts of large-scale conflict. Our work highlights the potential of HFPS to monitor active and large-scale conflicts, especially in contexts where conventional data sources are not immediately available.
articles.abstract_cn: 埃塞俄比亚最近经历了一场持续两年多的大规模战争。利用独特的、涵盖战争爆发前后数月的高频电话调查（HFPS）数据，本文提供了冲突对家庭粮食安全即时影响的证据。我们还评估了潜在机制，并评估了对邻近结果的影响，包括生计活动和进入食品市场的机会。我们使用双重差分和双向固定效应估计，比较受影响和未受影响地区（家庭）在战争爆发前后的趋势。冲突开始七个月后，我们发现战争与中度至重度粮食不安全概率增加37个百分点相关。利用武装冲突地点和事件数据（ACLED），我们表明额外经历一场战斗会使中度或重度粮食不安全的概率增加1个百分点。冲突通过供应链中断和限制非农生计活动，显著减少了获得食物的机会。非农和工资相关活动受影响最大，而农业活动相对更具韧性。我们的估计可能低估了对人口的真实平均影响，构成了大规模冲突近实时影响的新证据。我们的工作凸显了HFPS在监测活跃和大规模冲突方面的潜力，尤其是在传统数据来源无法立即获得的背景下。

articles.title_en: How does origin labelling on food packaging influence consumer product evaluation and choices? A systematic literature review
articles.title_cn: 食品包装上的原产地标签如何影响消费者产品评价与选择？一项系统性文献综述
articles.abstract_en: Research on why consumers consider the origin of food products important, how and why it influences consumer choices, and whether they understand and trust it, is fragmented and contradictory. This systematic review of recent, peer-reviewed research finds strong evidence that origin information has a substantial influence on consumers’ food choices. Consumers generally prefer domestic food products to imported and local or regional to other domestic, irrespective of the country or product. The origin becomes less important when trade-offs have to be made and in the presence of other quality cues on the product, such as organic, eco-, or quality assurance labels. Origin information primarily serves two purposes for consumers. First, many believe that food products from some origins are of better quality, safer, more environmentally friendly and in other ways superior to food products from other origins. Second, many consumers feel that it is their duty to support their local or domestic farmers and food industry. A strong ethnocentric bias emerges from the literature review, not only regarding the products consumers buy, but even more regarding their beliefs about products from different origins. In addition, consumers’ understanding and interpretation of information on the origin of food are impeded by a knowledge deficit. However, there is a need for studies digging deeper into deficiencies in consumers knowledge and understanding of origin information. There is also a need for research that disentangles the role of consumer ethnocentrism from other reasons why consumers are interested in origin information.
articles.abstract_cn: 关于消费者为何认为食品原产地重要、原产地如何及为何影响消费者选择，以及消费者是否理解并信任原产地信息的研究，是零散且相互矛盾的。这项对近期同行评审研究的系统性综述发现，强有力的证据表明原产地信息对消费者的食品选择具有显著影响。无论国家或产品如何，消费者普遍偏好国产食品而非进口食品，偏好本地或区域食品而非其他国内食品。当需要做出权衡且产品上存在其他质量线索（如有机、生态或质量保证标签）时，原产地的重要性会降低。原产地信息对消费者主要有两个用途。首先，许多人认为来自某些原产地的食品在质量、安全性、环保性及其他方面优于来自其他原产地的食品。其次，许多消费者认为支持本地或本国农民及食品产业是自己的责任。文献综述中显现出强烈的民族中心主义偏见，不仅体现在消费者购买的产品上，更体现在他们对不同原产地产品的信念上。此外，消费者对食品原产地信息的理解和解读受到知识匮乏的阻碍。然而，需要深入研究消费者在原产地信息方面的知识缺陷和理解不足。还需要研究将消费者民族中心主义的作用与消费者对原产地信息感兴趣的其他原因区分开来。

articles.title_en: Comparative resilience of US and EU meat processing to the Covid19 pandemic
articles.title_cn: 美国和欧盟肉类加工对新冠疫情的韧性比较
articles.abstract_en: Despite the similarities in the drop and recovery patterns of US and EU meat production during the Covid19 pandemic, the literature in the two continents assessed their respective meat processing industries’ resilience differently - resilient in the EU and non-resilient in the US but offered no resilience metrics in support of their assessments. We cast the differing transatlantic views in the context of the economic resilience literature and operationalize several metrics for cattle, pig, and chicken slaughter. We find the US less resilient than the EU in cattle and pig slaughter. Resilience in chicken slaughter depends on which metric is used. We discuss possible drivers of resilience and highlight how our metrics can be used for further research to inform resilience policy on both continents.
articles.abstract_cn: 尽管美国和欧盟在新冠疫情期间肉类产量的下降和恢复模式相似，但两大洲的文献对其各自肉类加工行业的韧性评估不同——欧盟被认为具有韧性，而美国被认为缺乏韧性，但未提供支持其评估的韧性指标。我们将跨大西洋的不同观点置于经济韧性文献的背景下，并为牛、猪和鸡的屠宰量操作化了多个指标。我们发现美国在牛和猪屠宰方面的韧性低于欧盟。鸡屠宰的韧性取决于所使用的指标。我们讨论了韧性的可能驱动因素，并强调了我们的指标如何用于进一步研究，以指导两大洲的韧性政策。
